title: Refined, Reliable and Reproducible: Algorithmic Analysis and Reimplementation of the Popcorn Void Finder
abstract: arXiv:2611.28882v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Cosmic voids are vast underdense regions of the Universe that encode valuable information about its large-scale structure and evolution. By extending spherical voids into overlapping sphere structures, the Popcorn Void Finder demonstrated an improved statistical characterization of cosmic void populations. However, its origin as a research prototype progressively hindered its maintainability and extensibility. Moreover, post-publication algorithmic modifications have not been systematically evaluated, leaving their statistical and computational consequences insufficiently characterized. In this work, we present a comprehensive reimplementation of the Popcorn Void Finder, prioritizing algorithmic transparency, maintainability, and reproducibility. We document the complete identification procedure, revisit the original algorithmic choices, and evaluate their statistical and computational consequences. Comparisons between implementations

translated_title: 精炼、可靠且可复现：Popcorn Void Finder 的算法分析与重新实现
translated_abstract: 宇宙空洞是宇宙中巨大的欠密集区域，蕴含着关于宇宙大尺度结构和演化的宝贵信息。通过将球形空洞扩展为相互重叠的球体结构，Popcorn Void Finder 展示了对宇宙空洞群体更优的统计表征能力。然而，其作为研究原型的出身逐渐阻碍了软件的可维护性和可扩展性。此外，论文发表后的算法修改尚未得到系统性评估，其统计和计算方面的后果也未得到充分表征。在本工作中，我们对 Popcorn Void Finder 进行了全面的重新实现，优先考虑算法透明性、可维护性和可复现性。我们记录了完整的空洞识别流程，重新审视了原始的算法设计选择，并评估了其统计和计算方面的后果。不同实现之间的比较……（摘要此处截断）
tldr: 本文对宇宙空洞查找工具 Popcorn Void Finder 进行了全面的重新实现，以算法透明性、可维护性和可复现性为核心，并系统评估了发表后算法修改所带来的统计与计算影响。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a comprehensive reimplementation of the Popcorn Void Finder, prioritizing algorithmic transparency, maintainability, and reproducibility, while systematically evaluating the statistical and computational consequences of post-publication algorithmic modifications.
